title: Evaluating ChatGPT as a Recommender System: A Rigorous Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's tendency to recommend frequently interacted popular items versus less popular long-tail items. This is measured using two beyond-accuracy metrics: Average Popularity of Long-Tail Items (APLT) and Average Rating-based Popularity (ARP), which calculate the popularity of items in a recommendation list based on the number of interactions each item has in the training data.
